name: The Earthen Ring
label: Quest
description: This journey marks the arrival of the Windshapers from Zephras to Azeroth as an advance vanguard following delays caused by cultist activity in Valanaar.…
intro: This journey marks the arrival of the Windshapers from Zephras to Azeroth as an advance vanguard following delays caused by cultist activity in Valanaar. Boarding a skycutter ship outside the lodge, travelers make landfall in Mulgore to meet Alaana Stormwalker and begin acclimating to a vast and dangerous new world.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The recent events with the cult have delayed my plans to travel to Azeroth and I must remain here in Valanaar for a time. You and a handful of other Windshapers will be our vanguard instead. Alaana Stormwalker will be waiting to receive our Windshapers upon arrival in Mulgore, and I'd encourage you to explore Azeroth while we finish our business here. We will join you soon.
When you are ready, please proceed to the dock just outside this lodge and board the skycutter ship there.

clips.title: Completion
paras: More adventurers from Zephras, I see. Wonderful. The winds surely favor us! It's going to take us some time to get ourselves established here, so you may want to take some time to explore this new land.
Azeroth is an exciting new world, but it's also a dangerous world. You'd do well to prepare yourself for this new adventure by familiarizing yourself with the lands nearby.
